name: flakehunter-airflow
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'set -e; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; AIRFLOW_VERSION=3.3.2; PYTHON_VERSION=$(python -c "import sys; print(f\"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}\")"); uv venv .venv; uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python "apache-airflow[http,github]==${AIRFLOW_VERSION}" -e . pytest respx ruff --constraint "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/airflow/constraints-${AIRFLOW_VERSION}/constraints-${PYTHON_VERSION}.txt"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'W=$(pwd); export AIRFLOW_HOME=$W/.airflow AIRFLOW__CORE__DAGS_FOLDER=$W/dags AIRFLOW__CORE__LOAD_EXAMPLES=False; mkdir -p $AIRFLOW_HOME $AIRFLOW__CORE__DAGS_FOLDER; pgrep -f "airflow standalone" >/dev/null || nohup $W/.venv/bin/airflow standalone > $AIRFLOW_HOME/standalone.log 2>&1 &'
